```{r}
skewness(df[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)

vars <- c("DengueCases", "MeanT","TotalRain", "AvgHum", "WindSp_mph", "SO2", "NO2", "NO", "CO", "O3", "PM2.5", "PM10")

for (var in vars) {
  original <- skewness(df[[var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  transformed_log <- skewness(log1p(df[[var]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  transformed_sqrt <- skewness(sqrt(df[[var]]), na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(var, ": Original =", round(original, 2), ", Transformed_log =", round(transformed_log, 2), ": Transformed_sqrt =", round(transformed_sqrt, 2), "\n")
}

```

```{r}
model <- glm.nb(DengueCases ~ 
                      # cb_MaxT +
                      cb_MeanT +
                      cb_AvgHum +
                      # cb_AH +
                      cb_TotalRain_log+
                      cb_WindSp_mph +
                      cb_SO2_log + 
                      cb_NO2_log + 
                      # cb_NO_log +
                      cb_CO_log + 
                      cb_O3_log + 
                      cb_PM25_log + 
                      ns(DOS, df=3*9) + 
                      factor(Month) + 
                      # factor(Season) +
                      factor(DOW) +
                      factor(Holiday) + offset(log(Population)), data = df)
```



```{r}
library(MASS)

# Initial AIC
current_aic <- AIC(model)

# Terms to try removing
terms_list <- c(#"cb_MaxT", 
                "cb_MeanT", "cb_AvgHum", 
                # "cb_AH", 
                "cb_TotalRain_log", "cb_WindSp_mph", "cb_SO2_log", "cb_NO2_log",  "cb_CO_log",
                "cb_O3_log", "cb_PM25_log", "factor(Month)", 
                # "factor(Season)", 
                "factor(DOW)", "factor(Holiday)")

# Backward elimination loop
repeat {
  aic_results <- data.frame(term=character(), AIC=double(), stringsAsFactors=FALSE)

  for (term in terms_list) {
    # Try removing one term
    formula_new <- as.formula(paste("DengueCases ~ . -", term))
    model_new <- try(update(model, formula_new), silent=TRUE)

    # If model updates successfully, record AIC
    if (!inherits(model_new, "try-error")) {
      aic_results <- rbind(aic_results, data.frame(term=term, AIC=AIC(model_new)))
    }
  }

  # If no more terms can be removed, break
  if (nrow(aic_results) == 0) break

  # Find the term whose removal results in the lowest AIC
  best <- aic_results[which.min(aic_results$AIC), ]

  # Compare with current model AIC
  if (best$AIC < current_aic) {
    # Update model
    message("Removing term: ", best$term, " | New AIC: ", best$AIC)
    model <- update(model, as.formula(paste("~ . -", best$term)))
    current_aic <- best$AIC
    terms_list <- setdiff(terms_list, best$term)  # Remove from list
  } else {
    break  # Stop if no AIC improvement
  }
}

# Final model
summary(model)

```

```{r}
AIC(model)
gvif_values <- vif(model)
print(gvif_values)


residuals <- residuals(model, type = "deviance", na.action = na.exclude)

# Load necessary package
library(stats)

# Plot ACF (Autocorrelation Function)
acf(residuals, main = "ACF of Deviance Residuals")

# Plot PACF (Partial Autocorrelation Function)
pacf(residuals, main = "PACF of Deviance Residuals")



# Compute ACF values without plotting
acf_res <- acf(residuals, plot = FALSE)

# Remove lag 0
acf_values <- acf_res$acf[-1]           # Remove first element (lag 0)
lag_values <- acf_res$lag[-1]           # Corresponding lags

# Plot manually without lag 0
plot(lag_values, acf_values, type = "h", 
     xlab = "Lag", ylab = "ACF", main = "ACF of Deviance Residuals",
     ylim = c(min(acf_values), max(acf_values)))
abline(h = 0)
abline(h = c(-1.96/sqrt(length(residuals)), 1.96/sqrt(length(residuals))), col = "blue", lty = 2)
```

```{r} #finidng the optimized lagged residual
library(MASS)     # for glm.nb
library(lmtest)   # for dwtest
library(splines)
library(dlnm)
library(zoo)      # for lag

# Define maximum number of lags to test
max_lags <- 20

# Storage for results
dw_results <- numeric(max_lags)
aic_results <- numeric(max_lags)

# Loop over number of lagged residuals
for (n_lags in 1:max_lags) {
  
  # Create temp data
  df_temp <- df[-c(1:48), ]
  
  # Add lagged deviance residuals
  for (i in 1:n_lags) {
    df_temp[[paste0("lag_residuals", i)]] <- lag(residuals, i)
  }
  
  # Rebuild cross-basis objects
  cb_MeanT_temp <- ns(df_temp$MeanT, df=Mdof)
  
  cb_AvgHum_temp <- ns(df_temp$AvgHum, df=Mdof)
  
  # cb_TotalRain_temp <- ns(df_temp$TotalRain, knots=c(4, 16))
  
  cb_TotalRain_log_temp <- ns(df_temp$TotalRain_log, knots=c(1.6, 2.8))

  cb_WindSp_mph_temp <- ns(df_temp$WindSp_mph, df=Mdof)
  
  cb_SO2_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$SO2, lag=Plag,
                         argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                         arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))
  
  
  cb_SO2_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$SO2_log, lag=Plag,
                         argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                         arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_NO2_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$NO2, lag=Plag,
                          argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                          arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_NO2_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$NO2_log, lag=Plag,
                          argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                          arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_NO_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$NO, lag=Plag,
                          argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                          arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_NO_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$NO_log, lag=Plag,
                          argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                          arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_CO_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$CO, lag=Plag,
                         argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                         arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_CO_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$CO_log, lag=Plag,
                         argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                         arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_O3_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$O3, lag=Plag,
                        argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                        arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))


  cb_O3_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$O3_log, lag=Plag,
                        argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                        arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))


  cb_PM25_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$PM2.5, lag=Plag,
                           argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                           arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_PM25_log_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$PM25_log, lag=Plag,
                           argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                           arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_PM25_sqrt_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$PM25_sqrt, lag=Plag,
                           argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                           arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))

  cb_PM10_temp <- crossbasis(df_temp$PM10, lag=Plag,
                           argvar=list(fun="ns", df=Pdof),
                           arglag=list(fun="ns", df=Pknots))
  
  # Add DOS index
  df_temp$DOS <- seq_len(nrow(df_temp)) 
  
  # Construct lagged residual terms in model formula
  lag_terms <- paste0("lag_residuals", 1:n_lags, collapse = " + ")
  
  # Create model formula
  model_formula <- as.formula(paste(
    "DengueCases ~ ns(DOS, df=3*9) + cb_MeanT_temp + 
                      # cb_AvgHum_temp +
                      # cb_TotalRain_log_temp +
                      # cb_WindSp_mph_temp +
                      cb_SO2_log_temp + 
                      cb_NO2_log_temp + 
                      cb_CO_log_temp + 
                      cb_O3_log_temp + 
                      cb_PM25_log_temp + ", lag_terms,
    "+ factor(Month) +
    # factor(DOW) +
    factor(Holiday) + offset(log(Population))"
  ))
  
  # Fit negative binomial model
  model_temp <- glm.nb(model_formula, data = df_temp)
  
  # Save AIC
  aic_results[n_lags] <- AIC(model_temp)
  
  # Compute residuals and DW
  resids <- residuals(model_temp, type = "deviance")
  lm_temp <- lm(resids ~ 1)
  dw_stat <- dwtest(lm_temp)$statistic
  dw_results[n_lags] <- dw_stat
  
  cat("Completed lag:", n_lags, "AIC =", round(aic_results[n_lags], 2), 
      "DW =", round(dw_stat, 3), "\n")
}

# Plot both AIC and DW
par(mfrow = c(2,1))  # two plots vertically

# AIC plot
plot(1:max_lags, aic_results, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of Lagged Residuals", ylab = "AIC",
     main = "AIC vs Number of Residual Lags")

# DW plot
plot(1:max_lags, dw_results, type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "Number of Lagged Residuals", ylab = "Durbin-Watson Statistic",
     main = "DW Statistic vs Number of Residual Lags")
abline(h = 2, col = "blue", lty = 2)

```

```{r}
acf_values <- acf_res$acf[-1]           # Remove first element (lag 0)
lag_values <- acf_res$lag[-1]           # Corresponding lags

# Plot manually without lag 0
plot(lag_values, acf_values, type = "h", 
     xlab = "Lag", ylab = "ACF", main = "ACF of Deviance Residuals",
     ylim = c(min(acf_values), max(acf_values)))
abline(h = 0)
abline(h = c(-1.96/sqrt(length(residuals)), 1.96/sqrt(length(residuals))), col = "blue", lty = 2)

```

```{r}
     cex.lab = 2.5,

     font.lab = 2,

     col.lab = "black",

     cex.main = 1.5,

)
```

#Wavelet Coherence Analysis

```{r}
tiff("path/file_name.tiff", width = 20, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300)


library(biwavelet)
library(readxl)

Data <- read_excel("data.xlsx")

A <- Data$DengueCases
B <- Data$PM10

Data$Date <- as.Date(Data$Date)
DATE <- 1:length(A)

WA <- cbind(DATE, A)
WB <- cbind(DATE, B)

nrands = 5000

# Wavelet parameters
dj <- 0.125
s0 <- 2

# Maximum desired period = 365 days
max_period <- 365

# Calculate J1 so that maximum scale does not exceed 365 days
J1 <- floor(log2(max_period / s0) / dj)


wtc.AB = wtc(WA, WB, mother = "morlet", sig.level = 0.95, sig.test  = 1, nrands = nrands, dj = dj, s0 = s0, J1 = J1)

# wtc.AB$period
# max(wtc.AB$period)
# range(wtc.AB$period)

# Plotting a graph
# par(oma = c(0, 0, 0, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 5, 5))
plot(wtc.AB, plot.phase = TRUE, lty.coi = 1, col.coi = "white", lwd.coi = 2, 
    lwd.sig = 1.0, arrow.lwd = 0.08, arrow.len = 0.15, arrow.col = "black", ylab = " ", 
    #ylim = c(2, 365),
    xlab = "", xaxt = "n", cex.lab = 1.7, cex.axis = 1.7, plot.cb = FALSE)


# Defining x labels
year_index <- which(format(Data$Date, "%m-%d") == "01-01")
year_labels <- format(Data$Date[year_index], "%Y")
axis(1, at = year_index, labels = year_labels, cex.axis = 1.7)

```
